description: This file implements the server-side logic for an audio connector in the Android Open Source Project, including socket creation, shared memory management, command processing, and client connection handling.

classes.name: AudioServer
classes.description: Manages client connections and accepts new audio client connections.

classes.name: AudioClientConnection
classes.description: Represents a connection to an audio client, handling command and data reception.

methods.name: AcceptClient
methods.description: Accepts a new client connection and creates an AudioClientConnection object.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new AudioClientConnection with shared memory and socket pairs.

methods.name: ReceiveCommands
methods.description: Receives and processes commands from the client.

methods.name: ReceivePlayback
methods.description: Receives playback data buffers from the client.

methods.name: ReceiveCapture
methods.description: Receives capture data buffers from the client.

methods.name: CmdReply
methods.description: Sends a command reply with status and optional data.

methods.name: ReceiveMsg
methods.description: Receives a message from a socket with error handling.
